# Business By Design - Aimee Skillin
## Business Success Strategist | Foundation, Frameworks & Freedom

> Aimee Skillin is a business success strategist with 12+ years of experience helping real estate agents and diverse entrepreneurs gain clarity, build solid foundations, and design scalable systems for sustainable growth. She is a native speaker of both English and Spanish.

## What is Business By Design?
Business By Design is a practical approach to building a sustainable, scalable business through three foundational pillars:
1. Foundation - Clear view of your time, priorities, and business base
2. Framework - Repeatable systems, workflows, and processes that scale
3. Freedom - Time-blocking, automation, and CRM strategies that give you your time back

## Services
- Free Sunday Masterclass (60-minute session, no cost)
- VIP Day (full 8-hour, one-on-one Business Systems Development session)
- Free 30-Minute Discovery Call
- Business coaching for real estate agents, solopreneurs, and service-based professionals

## What Makes This Different
Unlike other coaches and consultants who tell you WHAT to do, Aimee builds the systems WITH you so you know HOW to do it. You leave with tools and frameworks you can implement the very next day.
